nodes.name: Service Bus Trigger
nodes.notes: AMQP 1.0 listener no Topic 'tickets-escalated' / Subscription 'n8n-escalation-sub' do namespace sb-helpsphere-final. Sink format: '<topic>/Subscriptions/<subscription>' (AMQP entity path padrao Service Bus). Service Bus suporta AMQP 1.0 nativo (docs.microsoft.com/azure/service-bus-messaging/service-bus-amqp-overview). N8n nao tem first-party Azure Service Bus node — issue n8n-io/n8n#12959.

nodes.name: HTTP MCP — get_ticket
nodes.notes: Enriquece o ticket via MCP Server (Cap 05). Bearer token Entra cravado na credential 'MCP Server Bearer'. Retorna {ticket, similar_tickets, priority, confidenceScore}.

nodes.name: PostgreSQL — Log Audit

parameters.query: INSERT INTO escalation_audit (ticket_id, tenant_id, priority, confidence_score, mcp_response, routed_to, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Service Bus Trigger').item.json.body.ticket_id }},{{ $('Service Bus Trigger').item.json.body.tenant_id || 'default' }},{{ $('Service Bus Trigger').item.json.body.priority || $json.priority || 'medium' }},{{ $json.confidenceScore || 0.5 }},{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

nodes.notes: INSERT em escalation_audit (PG do n8n metadata DB OU PG dedicado de auditoria). Retorna id auto-gerado para correlação posterior. routed_to ainda NULL — preenchido pelo Switch downstream.

nodes.name: Switch — Priority Route
nodes.notes: Roteia por confidenceScore (>=0.7 → Teams card) OU priority='critical' (bypass direto Teams sem checagem confidence). Fallback → manual-review (apenas grava no Sheets/PG sem notificar Teams).

nodes.name: Microsoft Graph — Teams Adaptive Card
nodes.notes: Adaptive Card v1.5 com 4 actions: OpenUrl (HelpSphere) + 3 Submit (Aceitar/Rejeitar/Reatribuir). Action.Submit envia POST para WEBHOOK_URL do n8n com o data payload — abre handler em outro workflow.

nodes.name: HTTP PATCH — HelpSphere /tickets/{id}

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "status": "escalated",
  "escalated_at": "{{ $now.toISO() }}",
  "escalated_by": "{{ $('Service Bus Trigger').item.json.body.escalated_by || 'helpsphere-tier1-agent' }}",
  "escalation_audit_id": {{ $('PostgreSQL — Log Audit').item.json.id }},
  "escalation_reason": "{{ $('HTTP MCP — get_ticket').item.json.escalation_reason || 'auto-escalation via agente Tier-1' }}"
}

nodes.notes: PATCH HelpSphere API atualizando status='escalated' + carimbo de auditoria. Header x-functions-key (Bloco 2 backend) ou Bearer Entra (Lab Avancado).

nodes.name: Google Sheets — Append Audit Row
nodes.notes: Append linha na planilha 'Apex IA - Auditoria de Escalações HelpSphere' (Cap 08 Passo 8.5). Service Account email helpsphere-sheets-bot@<project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com com Editor sharing.
